sources.title: A Systematic Review of Key Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Systems ...
sources.snippet: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) represents a fundamental advancement in AI, bridging retrieval and generation for improved factuality and adaptability. This review highlights the evolution of RAG from early retrieve-and-read systems to sophisticated architectures integrating neural retrievers and sequence-to-sequence generators.

sources.title: Retrieval-augmented generation - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from external data sources. [1]
